duration.text: The Control Theory and Control Engineering at China University of Petroleum - Beijing is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/In total ￥ 35000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) 6.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7.The identity certificate of the guarantors charging your case in China For example, photocopy of ID card, photocopy of passport, etc.

requirements.text: 1.Aged under 50 years old; 2.Received a master degree in the relative subject from an authorized university or college. B is required for the record;
